target_analysis.name: ae_predictable_exists_bounded_history_policy
target_analysis.source_relation: Derived representation theorem for a formal model of the source strict-past prediction rule; not printed, and not an empirical-mean theorem.
target_analysis.objects: Any measure mu on a measurable Omega; arbitrary measurable-space Seed; functions S and Y; a family of information sigma fields F_t; real predictions.
target_analysis.assumptions: Only F_t<=comap H_t, AEStronglyMeasurable[F_t] prediction_t, and a.s. unit-interval predictions. No probability, IID, outcome support, measurability of S/Y, seed independence, or increasing-filtration premise.
target_analysis.conclusion: One family of measurable policies, globally [0,1]-valued for all seed/history inputs, equals prediction_t on the realized history for all t on one common full-measure event.
target_analysis.null_scope: For natural-number times, AE omega FORALL t and FORALL t AE omega are equivalent: countable intersection of the per-time full-measure events supplies one common full-measure event. This is an interchange of countable almost-everywhere quantifiers, not a mathematically stronger conclusion. It is not pointwise equality on all Omega.
target_analysis.boundary: Clamping may change null-set values or unrealized histories. The theorem does not identify unique policies, preserve off-support behavior, require bounded data, or claim pathwise equality everywhere.
target_analysis.zero: At t=0 the history index type is empty, so policy may depend on seed only.

target_analysis.name: ae_predictable_private_seed_independent
target_analysis.source_relation: Derived independence bridge supporting the page1 oracle/nonnegative claim under an explicit randomized ae-information model; not a printed independence lemma.
target_analysis.objects: Probability space, measurable independent observation sequence, measurable seed independent of the full stream, fixed t and a subinformation field F, an ae F-strongly-measurable real P.
target_analysis.assumptions: iIndepFun Y and seed independent of full observation vector; F<=comap seed-plus-past. No identical distribution, bounds on Y/P, monotonic filtration, or explicit-policy hypothesis.
target_analysis.conclusion: P and Y_t are independent under mu. This is a distributional fact; ae modifications preserve it.
target_analysis.null_scope: P may have arbitrary null-set changes. Representative independence must transfer to the original P.
target_analysis.boundary: Does not assert independence of P from the past or the full stream; P can use the past. Pairwise independence of P components or seed with each coordinate separately is insufficient to replace joint premises.
target_analysis.zero: At t=0 no observations are in the history; seed independence supplies the current-round independence.

target_analysis.name: ae_predictable_private_seed_expectedFixed_excess
target_analysis.source_relation: Derived exact expected-excess decomposition and nonnegative assertion extending source page1 to ae-predictable seeded policies, with a formal sInf benchmark. Not a printed named theorem or a convergence theorem.
target_analysis.objects: IID measurable unit-interval observations, independent measurable private seed, per-time information sigma fields below seed-plus-past, a.s. unit-interval ae-predictable process, finite natural horizon T.
target_analysis.assumptions: Probability, common observation law, iIndepFun, per-time a.s. observation/prediction bounds and ae strong measurability; no empirical-mean choice or increasing F premise.
target_analysis.conclusion: Expected loss minus the sInf over fixed expected comparator losses equals sum_{t<T} E[(prediction_t-EY_0)^2], and is nonnegative.
target_analysis.null_scope: Per-time a.s. assumptions suffice for finite-horizon integral identities; all-natural-time common exceptional set may be used via T1 but is not required by the direct T2 route.
target_analysis.boundary: The infimum is outside expectation. Do not replace it by expected pathwise minimum. No convergence-to-zero, regret rate, high-probability, a.s. success, or minimax conclusion is present.
target_analysis.zero: At T=0 expected fixed minimum is sInf{0}=0; equality and nonnegativity hold. No division or logarithm occurs.
